File helpers: encoding, SPSS variable names, compressed file paths, opening the browser

Source: R/files.R
kit_files.Rd

  • kit_fix_utf8_chr(): converts text to UTF-8 (characters that cannot be converted become ?); returns non-text input as is.

  • kit_fix_utf8_df(): converts every text column (and factor) of a data frame to UTF-8, keeping SAV variable labels and value labels.

  • kit_is_valid_utf8_df(): whether the column names and text columns are all valid UTF-8.

  • kit_sav_safe_names(): converts to valid SPSS variable names (tested against haven::write_sav(): only letters, digits, and _ . @ # $; starts with a letter or @; does not end with .; not a reserved word; at most 64 bytes; unique ignoring case, with _2, _3 added from the second duplicate on).

  • kit_truncate_bytes(): truncates by UTF-8 byte count without cutting a Chinese character in half.

  • kit_gz_path(): readr decides whether to decompress from the extension; if the path does not end in .gz, it copies the file to a temp file ending in .gz.

  • kit_open_browser(): opens the URL in the default browser (on Windows, unaffected by the RStudio viewer).

Usage

kit_fix_utf8_chr(x)

kit_fix_utf8_df(df)

kit_is_valid_utf8_df(df)

kit_sav_safe_names(cols)

kit_truncate_bytes(x, max_bytes)

kit_gz_path(path)

kit_open_browser(url)

Arguments

x

A character vector (kit_fix_utf8_chr()) or a single string (kit_truncate_bytes()).

df

A data frame.

cols

Column names.

max_bytes

Maximum number of bytes.

path

A file path.

url

A URL.

Value

An object of the same kind as the input; kit_is_valid_utf8_df() gives TRUE / FALSE; kit_open_browser() gives NULL.

Examples

kit_sav_safe_names(c("1st wave", "AND", "id", "ID"))
#> [1] "v_1st_wave" "AND_"       "id"         "ID_2"      
kit_truncate_bytes(strrep("測", 30), 64)
#> [1] "測測測測測測測測測測測測測測測測測測測測測"
